case_title: THE MEDICAL CLINIC FOR REHABILITATION et al VS NORTHERN CA BUTCHER UNIONS EMPLOYERS MEDICAL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $223.30 FILED BY THE MEDICAL CLINIC FOR REHABILITATION MR. LEUNG EDWIN AS TO DEFENDANT NORTHERN CA BUTCHER UNIONS EMPLOYERS MEDICAL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-15-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT NORTHERN CA BUTCHER UNIONS EMPLOYERS MEDICAL

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF THE MEDICAL CLINIC FOR REHABILITATION MR. LEUNG EDWIN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT NORTHERN CA BUTCHER UNIONS EMPLOYERS MEDICAL DEFT FAILED TO EXHAUST ADMINISTRATIVE REMEDIES AS REQUIRED BY TRUST AGREEMENT(1990-P.38) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
